definitions.full: H6131. aqar [ עָקַר ] verb denominative pluck or root up — Qal Infinitive construct לַעֲקוֺר with accusative Eccl 3:2 (opposed to נָטַע ). Niph`al Imperfect 3feminine singular תֵּעָקֵר עֶקְרוֺן Zeph 2:4 (word-play). עִקֵּר verbPi`eldenom (from עֵקַר or other like word = ( root-sinew ), hamstring ; — hamstring horses (on Arabic funeral usage, with camel and horse see We Heid. 2, 181 ): Perfect 3masculine singular ׳ע Josh 11:9 , Imperfect 3masculine singular וַיְעַקֵּר 2Sam 8:4 = 1Chr 18:4 , 2 masculine singular תְּעַקֵּר Josh 11:6 all with accusative; Perfect 3masculine plural שׁוֺר עִקְּרוּ Gen 49:6 they hamstrung an ox .
